title: Gingiva thickening with a porcine collagen matrix in a preclinical dog model: Histological outcomes
authors: Schmitt CM, Schlegel KA, Gammel L, Moest T. J Clin Periodontol. 2019 Dec;46(12):1273-1281. doi: 10.1111/jcpe.13196.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “SCTG is superior to mucoderm® with regard to CTT in this experimental model. The mucoderm and the SCTG lead to comparable connective tissue quality ten months after connective tissue thickening” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
